title: Import patients from a spreadsheet
summary: The import wizard reads an Excel or CSV file, lets you map columns, validates and only then imports.

steps.title: Choose what to import
steps.details: Choose Patients. You can import from Excel or CSV; the wizard detects columns and lets you correct the mapping.
steps.description: Select Patients. Then you upload the file, review how the columns are mapped and validate.

steps.title: Continue with the wizard
steps.details: Each step is validated before continuing. Nothing is imported until the final confirmation, and errors are shown row by row.
steps.description: Press Next on each step. Nothing is imported until the final confirmation.
